name: AIX Theme
description: Reusable AIX UI/UX component library on Next.js. Every page/block/primitive has a stable reference ID.

conventions.pageId: AIX-### (ranges: 010-049 dashboards, 050-099 ecommerce, 100-149 apps, 150-199 ai-tools, 200-299 ui-elements, 300-349 forms-tables, 350-399 charts-maps, 400-449 misc-pages, 450-499 auth, 500-549 errors, 550-599 layouts)
conventions.blockId: AIX-###.N — Nth top-level block on the page
conventions.frameId: AIX-F1 sidebar, AIX-F2 topbar, AIX-F3 breadcrumb, AIX-F4 content, AIX-F5 sidebar-cta

blocks.description: Searchable index of all pages, blocks, and primitives (rendered from aix-manifest.json)

Mail surface: select-all/bulk-action toolbar, Primary/Team/Updates tabs, Gmail rows (star, unread dot, hover swaps time for archive/delete/read/snooze), in-place thread view with prev/next and quick reply, 1-15 of 128 paging
Compose card docked bottom-right (minimizable, To/Subject/body, orange Send); full-width sheet on mobile
Four StatCards: transcripts synced, hours transcribed, action items extracted, awaiting sync
Scribe sync info banner with last-sync timestamp
Transcript list table: meeting title, date, duration, participant avatar stack, Zoom/Meet/Teams source badge, Synced/Processing status, Open link
Meeting header: title, source badge, date/duration, participant avatars, Download/Share
AI summary card with key-point bullets
Action items checklist with owner avatars and due chips
Key moments with orange mono timestamp chips
Full transcript speaker turns with expand button

Code generator panel (prompt composer + code output)
Video generator panel (prompt composer + video previews)
AI settings panel (model, behavior, brand voice)
Sam conversation thread with source chips, action items, context toggle chips, composer
Context card: surfaces Sam can see (transcripts, inbox, tasks, calendar) with counts and links
Suggested prompts card, chips prefill the composer
Embedded video examples in aspect-ratio grids
Bordered ring spinner for inline/button loaders
Quota attainment by agent radial chart
